paite: Huan TOUPA'N Mosi ahoupih a,
heading: Sabiak Kutte
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

paite: "Israel suante houpih inla, akiang uah, 'TOUPA ankuanglui hunbi hiaite ahi.
english: “Speak to the children of Israel, and tell them, ‘The set feasts of Yahweh, which you shall proclaim to be holy convocations, even these are my set feasts.

paite: Ni guk sung nna na sem ding ua, ani sagih ni khawlna Sabbath ni ahi a, khawmpi siangthou ahi. Hiai ni in nna na sem ding uh ahi kei. Na tenna teng uah hiai TOUPA Sabbath ni ahi.
english: “‘Six days shall work be done: but on the seventh day is a Sabbath of solemn rest, a holy convocation; you shall do no kind of work. It is a Sabbath to Yahweh in all your dwellings.

paite: TOUPA ankuanglui hunbi, khawmpi siangthou, ahun geihgeih a na puankhiak ding uh hiaite ahi,' achi hi.
english: “‘These are the set feasts of Yahweh, even holy convocations, which you shall proclaim in their appointed season.

paite: "Akha khatna, ani sawm-le-li nitaklam in TOUPA Paikan Ankuang akipan ding hi.
heading: Paikan Ankuang Leh Tanghou Silngou Soh Louh / (Nam 28.16-25)
english: In the first month, on the fourteenth day of the month in the evening, is Yahweh’s Passover.

paite: Huai kha mah ni sawm-le-nga TOUPA a dia silngou soh louh tanghou ankuang ahi a, ni sagih sung silngou soh louh tanghou na ne ding uh ahi.
english: On the fifteenth day of the same month is the feast of unleavened bread to Yahweh. Seven days you shall eat unleavened bread.

paite: Ani khat ni in khawmpi siangthou na nei ding ua, nna himhim na sem ding uh ahi kei.
english: In the first day you shall have a holy convocation. You shall do no regular work.

paite: Ni sagih sung mei a thillat TOUPA kiang ah na lan ding ua; ani sagih ni pen khawmpi siangthou ahi a, nna himhim na sem ding uh ahi kei, chi in," achi hi.
english: But you shall offer an offering made by fire to Yahweh seven days. In the seventh day is a holy convocation: you shall do no regular work.’”

paite: TOUPA'N Mosi ahoupih a,
heading: Kalte Kut
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

paite: "Israel suante houpih inla, akiang uah, k'on gam piak ding na va tun ua, huai a buh na lak chiang un, na buh thak masate uh phal khat siampu kiang a na hon tawi ding uh ahi.
english: “Speak to the children of Israel, and tell them, ‘When you have come into the land which I give to you, and shall reap its the harvest, then you shall bring the sheaf of the first fruits of your harvest to the priest:

paite: Pomsak theih na hihna ding un, ama'n buhphal pen TOUPA ma ah hon na veisak dia; Sabbath zingchiang in siampu in avei ding ahi.
english: and he shall wave the sheaf before Yahweh, to be accepted for you. On the next day after the Sabbath the priest shall wave it.

paite: Buhphal na vei ni un belamnoupa, gensiatbei, kum khat a upa halmang thillat ding in TOUPA kiang ah na lan ding uh ahi.
english: On the day when you wave the sheaf, you shall offer a male lamb without blemish a year old for a burnt offering to Yahweh.

paite: Tangbuang thillat bel tangbuang nel chi ephah mun sawm a khen mun nih sathau a mek, TOUPA a dia gimlim, mei a thillat ahi ding ahi. Dawn thillat ahihleh uain hin mun li a khen mun khat ahi ding ahi.
english: The meal offering with it shall be two tenth parts of an ephah 1 ephah is about 22 litres or about 2/3 of a bushel of fine flour mingled with oil, an offering made by fire to Yahweh for a pleasant aroma; and the drink offering with it shall be of wine, the fourth part of a hin.

paite: Na Pathian uh a dia thillat na lat ma un, huai ma himhim in tanghou hiam, kan thoh hiam, an thak hitaleh na ne ding uh ahi kei. Hiai na tenna teng ua na suante zel uh tan a na tangtawn dan thuseh ding uh ahi.
english: You shall eat neither bread, nor roasted grain, nor fresh grain, until this same day, until you have brought the offering of your God. This is a statute forever throughout your generations in all your dwellings.

paite: "Sabbath zingchiang vei thillat buhphal na hon tawi ni ua pan in na sim ding ua, Sabbath sagihvei aching ding ahi.
heading: Pawltak Kut / (Nam 28.6-31)
english: “‘You shall count from the next day after the Sabbath, from the day that you brought the sheaf of the wave offering; seven Sabbaths shall be completed:

paite: Sabbath sagihveina zingsang a pan ni sawmnga na sim ding ua, TOUPA kiang a tangbuang thak thillat na lat ding uh ahi.
english: even to the next day after the seventh Sabbath you shall number fifty days; and you shall offer a new meal offering to Yahweh.

paite: Na tenna mun ua pan in ephah mun sawm a khen mun nih a bawl, tanghou beu vei ding nih, tangbuang nel chi, silngou toh kan, TOUPA a dia gah masa vei thillat a lat dia na hon tawi ding uh ahi.
english: You shall bring out of your habitations two loaves of bread for a wave offering made of two tenth parts of an ephah of fine flour. They shall be baked with yeast, for first fruits to Yahweh.

paite: Tanghou lat toh kituak in belamnou sagih gensiatbei, kum khat a upa leh bawngtuai leh belampa nih na lan ding uh ahi. Huaite atangbuang thillat uh leh adawn thillat uh toh, TOUPA a dia halmang thillat, TOUPA a dia gimlim, mei a thillat ahi ding hi.
english: You shall present with the bread seven lambs without blemish a year old, one young bull, and two rams. They shall be a burnt offering to Yahweh, with their meal offering, and their drink offerings, even an offering made by fire, of a sweet aroma to Yahweh.

paite: Khelh thoihna ding in kelpa khat leh kilemna thillat kithoihna ding in belamnou apa nih kum khat a upa na lat ding uh ahi.
english: You shall offer one male goat for a sin offering, and two male lambs a year old for a sacrifice of peace offerings.

paite: Siampu in gah masa a bawl tanghou, belamnou nih toh TOUPA ma a vei thillat in avei dia; siampu a tuam, TOUPA a dia siangthou ahi ding.
english: The priest shall wave them with the bread of the first fruits for a wave offering before Yahweh, with the two lambs. They shall be holy to Yahweh for the priest.

paite: Huai ni mah na sep ding ua, nou a ding in khawmpi siangthou ahi dia, nna himhim na sem ding uh ahi kei. Hiai na tenna teng uah na suante uh tan in tangtawn dan thuseh ding ahi.
english: You shall make proclamation on the same day: there shall be a holy convocation to you; you shall do no regular work. This is a statute forever in all your dwellings throughout your generations.

paite: "Na lou ua buh na lak chiang un na lounawl zul uh la vek kei un. Asang leng na zong ding uh ahi kei. Mizawng leh gamdangmi a dia na hawisak ding uh ahi. Kei TOUPA na Pathian uh ka hi, chi in," achi hi.
english: “‘When you reap the harvest of your land, you shall not wholly reap into the corners of your field, neither shall you gather the gleanings of your harvest: you shall leave them for the poor, and for the foreigner. I am Yahweh your God.’”

paite: TOUPA'N Mosi ahoupih a,
heading: Kum Thak Kut / (Nam 29.1-6)
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

paite: "Israel suante houpih inla, akiang uah, akha sagihna huai kha ani khat ni, noute a ding in khawlna ni ahi dia; pengkul mut in theihgigena khawmpi siangthou ahi ding.
english: “Speak to the children of Israel, saying, ‘In the seventh month, on the first day of the month, shall be a solemn rest to you, a memorial of blowing of trumpets, a holy convocation.

paite: Nna himhim na sem ding uh ahi kei; TOUPA a dia mei a thillat na lan ding uh ahi, chi in,” achi hi.
english: You shall do no regular work; and you shall offer an offering made by fire to Yahweh.’”

paite: TOUPA'N Mosi ahoupih a,
heading: Thoihna Ni / (Nam 29.12-40)
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

paite: "Akha sagihna ani sawm ni Thoihna Ni ahi a; nou a ding in khawmpi siangthou ahi ding. Na lungsimte uh zangsak unla, TOUPA a ding in mei a thillat lan un.
english: “However on the tenth day of this seventh month is the day of atonement: it shall be a holy convocation to you, and you shall afflict yourselves; and you shall offer an offering made by fire to Yahweh.

paite: Huai ni in bang nna peuh na sem ding uh ahi kei. TOUPA na Pathian uh ma a lemna bawlsak ding, Thoihna Ni lah ahi ngal a.
english: You shall do no kind of work in that same day; for it is a day of atonement, to make atonement for you before Yahweh your God.

paite: Huai ni kigimsak lou peuhmah, amite a pan satkhiak ahi ding.
english: For whoever it is who shall not deny himself in that same day; shall be cut off from his people.

paite: Kuapeuh hi hen aw, huai ni a bang nna peuh sem, achipihte uh lak a pan ka satkhe ding hi.
english: Whoever it is who does any kind of work in that same day, that person I will destroy from among his people.

paite: Bang nna himhim na sem ding uh ahi kei. Hiai bel na tenna peuh ua na suante zel uh tan a tangtawn dan thuseh ding ahi.
english: You shall do no kind of work: it is a statute forever throughout your generations in all your dwellings.

paite: Nou a ding in khawlna Sabbath ni ahi a; na kigimsak ding uh ahi. Huai kha ani kua ni nitaklam, huai kha nitaklam a pan nitaklam nawn tan Sabbath ni in na zang ding uh ahi,” achi hi.
english: It shall be a Sabbath of solemn rest for you, and you shall deny yourselves. In the ninth day of the month at evening, from evening to evening, you shall keep your Sabbath.”

paite: TOUPA'N Mosi ahoupih a,
heading: Biakbuk Ankuangluina / (Nam 29.12-40)
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

paite: "Israel suante houpih inla, akiang uah, akha sagihna ani sawm-le-nga ni TOUPA a ding in ni sagih sung Biakbuk Ankuang ahi ding hi.
english: “Speak to the children of Israel, and say, ‘On the fifteenth day of this seventh month is the feast of tents for seven days to Yahweh.

paite: Ani khatna pen khawmpi siangthou ahi dia, nna himhim na sem ding uh ahi kei.
english: On the first day shall be a holy convocation: you shall do no regular work.

paite: Ni sagih sung in mei a thillat TOUPA kiang ah na lan ding ua, ani giat ni nou a ding in khawmpi siangthou ahi ding. Mei a thillat TOUPA kiang ah na lan ding ua; khawmpi bei ni ahi a, nna himhim na sem ding uh ahi kei.
english: Seven days you shall offer an offering made by fire to Yahweh. On the eighth day shall be a holy convocation to you; and you shall offer an offering made by fire to Yahweh. It is a solemn assembly; you shall do no regular work.

paite: "Hiaite ahi, TOUPA ankuangluina hunbi, TOUPA a dia mei a thillat, halmang thillat, tangbuang thillat, kithoihna, dawn thillat, ani tuam chiat a lan dia khawmpi siangthou na zat dingte uh;
english: “‘These are the appointed feasts of Yahweh, which you shall proclaim to be holy convocations, to offer an offering made by fire to Yahweh, a burnt offering, and a meal offering, a sacrifice, and drink offerings, each on its own day;

paite: TOUPA Sabbathte, na thilpiakte uh, na thuchiam tengteng uh, amah ut thu a thillat, TOUPA kiang a na thillat zelte uh ban ah.
english: besides the Sabbaths of Yahweh, and besides your gifts, and besides all your vows, and besides all your freewill offerings, which you give to Yahweh.

paite: "Akha sagihna ni sawm-le-nga ni a na lou ua thilpiangte na lak khit chiang un TOUPA ankuangluina ni sagih na zang ding ua; ani khatna ni khawl kinkenna ni ahi dia, ani giat ni leng khawl kinkenna mah ahi ding hi.
english: “‘So on the fifteenth day of the seventh month, when you have gathered in the fruits of the land, you shall keep the feast of Yahweh seven days: on the first day shall be a solemn rest, and on the eighth day shall be a solemn rest.

paite: Ani khat ni in singkung hoihte gahte, tum sing hiangte, singbawkpha hiangte, lui a muisumte na tawi ding ua, TOUPA na Pathian uh ma ah ni sagih sung kipak in na om ding uhi.
english: You shall take on the first day the fruit of goodly trees, branches of palm trees, and boughs of thick trees, and willows of the brook; and you shall rejoice before Yahweh your God seven days.

paite: Hiai ankuangluina bel TOUPA a dia kum chih a ni sagih sung na zat ding uh ahi. Hiai na suante uh zel tan a tangtawn dan thuseh ding ahi. Akha sagihna ana zat zel ding uh ahi.
english: You shall keep it a feast to Yahweh seven days in the year: it is a statute forever throughout your generations; you shall keep it in the seventh month.

paite: Sawlbuk ah ni sagih sung na teng ding ua, Israel mi a piang himhim aidakbuk ah na ten vek ding uh ahi.
english: You shall dwell in booths seven days. All who are native-born in Israel shall dwell in booths,

paite: Huchi in na suante un Israel suante Aigupta gam a pan ka pikhiak lai in aidakbuk ah ka tengsak, chih athei ding uh. Kei TOUPA na Pathian uh ka hi, chi in," achi hi.
english: that your generations may know that I made the children of Israel to dwell in booths, when I brought them out of the land of Egypt. I am Yahweh your God.’”

paite: Huchi in Mosi in TOUPA an-kuangluina hunbite Israel suante kiang ah apuangta hi.
english: Moses declared to the children of Israel the appointed feasts of Yahweh.
